elements.element: Services must be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no professional-and-workmanlike performance warranty. The media workmanship warranty does not address performance of Services.

elements.element: Software and applicable software deliverables must conform to the Documentation.
elements.evidence: Commerce One warrants that the Software will perform in substantial accordance with the Documentation.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty must last 12 months.
elements.evidence: The rendered Warranty Period is only 90 days from the Effective Date.

elements.element: Services and applicable service deliverables must conform to the Documentation.
elements.evidence: Commerce One warrants that the MarketSite.net Service will perform in substantial accordance with the Documentation.

elements.element: The services conformance warranty must last 90 days.
elements.evidence: The shared Warranty Period for the MarketSite.net Service is 90 days from the Effective Date.

elements.element: Repair or correction must be available as a conformance-warranty remedy.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must use all commercially reasonable efforts to correct nonconforming Software and the MarketSite.net Service.

elements.element: Replacement must be available as a conformance-warranty remedy.
elements.evidence: If correction is reasonably not possible, Commerce One must replace the Software and MarketSite.net Service free of charge.

elements.element: A refund must be available as a conformance-warranty remedy.
elements.evidence: If a warranty breach cannot reasonably be corrected, Corio may terminate and receive a refund of all prepaid fees.

elements.element: The Services, Software, and deliverables must comply with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no warranty or obligation concerning compliance with applicable laws.

elements.element: The Software and relevant deliverables or services must be free of malicious code.
elements.evidence: The warranty is limited to the 90-day Warranty Period and covers only willfully introduced viruses and similar programs or data designed to disable, erase, or alter software or data. It does not provide an unqualified no-malicious-code warranty.

elements.element: Software and applicable software deliverables must conform to the Documentation.
elements.evidence: Commerce One warrants that the Software will perform in substantial accordance with the Documentation.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty must last at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The rendered Warranty Period is 90 days from the Effective Date, and the former December 31, 1999 outside date has been removed.

elements.element: Services and applicable service deliverables must conform to the Documentation.
elements.evidence: Commerce One warrants that the MarketSite.net Service will perform in substantial accordance with the Documentation.

elements.element: The services conformance warranty must last at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: The MarketSite.net Service receives the shared 90-day Warranty Period, exceeding the 30-day fallback minimum.

elements.element: Repair or correction must be available as a conformance-warranty remedy.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must use all commercially reasonable efforts to correct nonconforming Software and the MarketSite.net Service.

result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback by providing a 90-day software and service conformance warranty, removing the potentially truncating outside date, and retaining correction, replacement, and refund remedies. It does not reach the preferred position because it lacks a 12-month software warranty, a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, and a compliance-with-laws warranty, and its malicious-code warranty is qualified. The edits are confined to the shared warranty duration and obsolete outside date and do not disturb unrelated commercial terms.
